title: TOEIC 每日練習 Day 24（2026-11-21）
summary: 最新成績仍是 Day 15 的 15/25（Day 16 之後還沒交卷）。今天繼續加強兩大弱點：keep／find／consider + 受詞 + 形容詞（3 題，含 extremely useful 副詞對照），以及閱讀、聽力的「時間細節干擾」（原本時間、午餐、結束時間、備案時間混在選項裡）。另外複習 if 子句配 will／could、Despite／Although 對照、comply with、whose／who、be responsible for、on + 日期。聽力今天是 Part 4 電話留言。做完按「交卷」就會自動回傳成績

sections.heading: Part 5 文法與字彙（建議 11 分鐘）
sections.tip: find／keep／consider + 受詞 + 空格：描述受詞用形容詞（very 後面也是形容詞）；空格後面若還有形容詞，空格就是副詞。假設語氣先看主要子句：will 配 if 現在式，would／could 配 if 過去式。Although 接句子，Despite 接名詞。有日期就用 on。

qs.stem: If the weather ------- clear tomorrow, the team will hold the picnic in the park.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 will hold ＝ 真實可能發生。2. if 子句用現在式，the weather 單數用 stays。3. 選 A。

qs.stem: If we ------- a larger budget, we could hire two more engineers.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 could hire ＝ 與現在事實相反（其實預算不夠）。2. if 子句用過去式 had。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: The manager keeps the storage room ------- at all times.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. keep + 受詞（the storage room）+ 空格，描述房間的狀態。2. 房間是「被鎖上的」，用過去分詞當形容詞 locked。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: Customers found the new checkout process very -------.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. find + 受詞（the new checkout process）+ very + 空格。2. very 後面要形容詞，描述受詞用 convenient。3. 選 C。very 只是程度副詞，不改變詞性判斷。

qs.stem: The staff considered the training session ------- useful.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. consider + 受詞 + 空格 + useful。2. 空格後已經有形容詞 useful，空格修飾 useful，用副詞 extremely。3. 選 B。口訣：空格後還有形容詞 → 副詞；沒有 → 形容詞。

qs.stem: ------- the heavy traffic, most employees arrived on time.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. the heavy traffic 是名詞片語，沒有動詞。2. 讓步接名詞用介系詞 Despite。3. 選 B。Although、Unless 是連接詞，要接句子。

qs.stem: ------- the store opened only last month, it already has many regular customers.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後有主詞 the store＋動詞 opened，是句子。2. 讓步接句子用 Although。3. 選 C。

qs.stem: All drivers are required to comply ------- the new parking regulations.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：comply with ＝ 遵守。看到 comply 直接選 with。

qs.stem: The company is looking for a supplier ------- products meet international standards.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後先出現名詞 products，再接動詞 meet。2. 「那家供應商『的』產品」。3. 選 whose。

qs.stem: The woman ------- answered the phone said Mr. Park was out of the office.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後直接接動詞 answered，缺主詞。2. 先行詞是人，用 who。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: Ms. Chen is responsible ------- ordering office supplies.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. be responsible for ＝ 負責。2. 選 B。對照：be in charge of 用 of。

qs.stem: The annual sales conference will be held ------- March 15.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 時刻用 at；星期、日期用 on；月份、年份用 in。2. March 15 是日期，選 C。陷阱：看到 March 不要直接選 in，有日期就用 on。

sections.heading: Part 7 短篇閱讀（建議 9 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先讀題目、圈關鍵字（Why、What time、Where、NOT），再回原文找那一句。看到 now、instead of，代表新的時間或地點。NOT 題要每個選項都回原文核對。
passage: To: All Sales Staff / From: Daniel Ortiz / Subject: Change to Friday's training

The customer service training that was planned for Friday morning at 9:00 A.M. has been moved to Friday afternoon. It will now begin at 1:30 P.M. and end at 4:00 P.M. The trainer's flight arrives later than expected.
The session will take place in Meeting Room B instead of the main conference hall, which is being painted this week. Lunch will be provided at 12:30 P.M. in the staff kitchen for everyone attending.
Please bring your laptop. If you cannot attend, let me know by Thursday at noon.

qs.stem: Why was the e-mail sent?
opts: To invite staff to a lunch party
To ask staff to paint a room
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 目的題看主旨和第一句：Change to Friday's training、has been moved。2. 選 B。

qs.stem: What time will the training begin?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. It will now begin at 1:30 P.M.，now 表示新的時間。2. 選 C。A 9:00 是「原本」時間；B 12:30 是午餐；D 4:00 是結束時間，都是時間細節干擾。

qs.stem: Where will the training be held?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. in Meeting Room B instead of the main conference hall。2. instead of 前面是新地點 → 選 B。A 是舊地點陷阱；C 是吃午餐的地方。

qs.stem: What is NOT mentioned in the e-mail?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. NOT 題要逐一刪除：laptop 有提、Lunch will be provided 有提、flight arrives later 有提。2. 證書完全沒提 → 選 D。

sections.heading: Part 2 聽力應答（建議 6 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先聽清楚第一個字（Why don't we／or／How long／Didn't／Who／When）。Why don't we 是建議，不選 Because；A or B 問句和 Wh 問句不選 Yes。重複題目的字或發音相近的字（approve／prove、launch／lunch）通常是陷阱。

qs.stem: Why don't we order lunch from the new Thai restaurant?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Why don't we…? ＝ 建議「我們何不……」。2. B 接受建議。3. A 是 Because 陷阱；C 重複 order 的陷阱。

qs.stem: Would you like to sit by the window or near the door?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. A or B 選擇疑問句，先刪 Yes。2. B 選 window。3. C 重複 door。

qs.stem: How long will the repairs take?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. How long 問「多久」（一段時間）。2. A「大約兩天」。3. B since 是「從何時開始」；C 是 Yes 陷阱又重複 long。

qs.stem: Didn't Ms. Rivera approve the budget?
opts: Yes, she signed it this morning.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 把 not 拿掉：Did Ms. Rivera approve the budget?。2. A「有，她今天早上簽了」。3. B 重複 budget；C 用 approve／prove 發音陷阱。

qs.stem: Who should I give these documents to?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Who 問人。2. B「交給 Hall 先生」。3. A 是 Yes 陷阱；C 回答地點。

qs.stem: When is the new product launch?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. When 問時間。2. A「延到五月」是間接回答時間。3. B 重複 launch；C 用 launch／lunch 發音陷阱。

sections.heading: Part 4 電話留言（建議 4 分鐘）
sections.tip: 播放前先讀三題，圈出 Why、When、ask。留言會出現很多時間：原本的、新的、備案、回電期限。要選 now…instead 的那個新時間。要求題聽 Please…。
script: Woman: Hello, this is Karen Wu calling from Brightway Office Furniture about your order of six desks.
Woman: We originally planned to deliver them on Tuesday morning, but one of our trucks broke down. We can now deliver them on Thursday at ten A.M. instead.
Woman: If Thursday doesn't work for you, we also have an opening on Friday at two P.M. Please call me back at 555-0148 by Wednesday to confirm the time. Thank you.

qs.stem: Why is the speaker calling?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 目的題聽開頭：about your order…, originally planned…, now deliver…instead。2. 選 B。

qs.stem: When will the desks most likely be delivered?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 聽 now…instead：Thursday at ten A.M. instead。2. Tuesday 是原本時間；Wednesday 是回電期限；Friday 只是備案（If Thursday doesn't work）。3. 選 C。

qs.stem: What does the speaker ask the listener to do?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 要求題聽 Please…：Please call me back。2. call back ＝ return a call，換句話說。3. 選 B。
